answer_1.quote: Powerful LLMs, in the form of instruction-tuned, prompt-based generative models such as ChatGPT and GPT-4, have found widespread adoption reaching far beyond the NLP community. Part of this success story is the casting of heterogeneous NLP tasks into sequence-to-sequence tasks; which in turn enables extreme multi-task learning, and cross-task transfer learning.

answer_3.quote: One proposal to solve this issue is to evaluate on a wide variety of task-agnostic user inputs and report an aggregate metric. This approach has the potential to cover a wider range of use cases, however, it relies mostly on manual preference annotations from human labelers or larger LLMs which is costly and has no accepted protocol yet.
